message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I couldn’t help but feel a bit smug as I pulled out my trusty flashlight and power banks. My partner was fumbling around looking for candles, and I casually reminded them of my little emergency prep project. 

We ended up cozying up with our lantern and charged phones, enjoying a game night instead of stressing out. It’s funny how a little planning can turn an inconvenience into a fun memory! 

What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a power outage?
